full.label: fully explained
full.definition: A recorded origin — a PIE etymon carried by cited laws, or the record's own registered construction of explained pieces — reproduced exactly, every recorded intermediate matching.

adjusted.label: fully explained, with adjustments
adjusted.definition: The same path, but a recorded intermediate disagrees, or one step is an approved adjustment of ours.

partial.label: partially explained
partial.definition: A recorded chain that does not reach the word from the PIE etymon: it starts lower, or the laws do not reproduce it.

non_pie.label: non-PIE
non_pie.definition: Recorded as borrowed from outside the family.

unidentified.label: unidentified
unidentified.definition: Not held yet; an estimate, never a counted word.

ie_loan.label: loan from another IE language
ie_loan.definition: Borrowed from a sister branch; recorded, not derived by this chain.

built.label: built from its own words
built.definition: Made of the language's own words, or of one plus a suffix: a formation, not a derivation.
